items.title: Warren Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 17, 2018
items.q: my grandmother, my father’s mother, still lived in the country so we’d go down there every year and visit with her.

ctx.x: Sort of like a New Orleans family, where it’s just —

Yes. Yeah my father came from North Carolina, my mother was born outside of Chicago in Maywood, Illinois. And you know, my grandfather had been a chef on the Chicago Northwestern Railroad. So he was used to traveling back and forth from California and whatnot. And I didn’t really know my paternal grandfather but my grandmother, my father’s mother, still lived in the country so we’d go down there every year and visit with her. She lived to be 103. And that grandfather on my mother’s side, he lived to be about 106.…
